In [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]], after the forces of [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] [[Obroa-skai information raid|raided]] the library [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Obroa-skai/Legends|Obroa-skai]], they were pursued by a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] task force under the command of an [[Unidentified Elomin task force commander|Elomin officer]]. The task force engaged Thrawn's forces near the [[Obroa-skai system/Legends|Obroa-skai system]], but Thrawn's tactical genius enabled him to '''destroy''' the task force by playing off of the [[Elomin/Legends|Elomin's]] psychological weaknesses.

The [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Chimaera/Legends|''Chimaera'']] waited for the arrival of the [[Scout ship (TIE model)|scout ships]] sent to conduct the raid. As the craft arrived, Captain [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]], commanding officer of the ''Chimaera'', shifted the sentry line to yellow alert after reports that they had been followed and consulted [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] on how to proceed. Thrawn disregarded the scout wing commander's belief that they had lost their pursuers; shortly thereafter a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] pursuit force of four [[Assault Frigate Mark I|Assault Frigates]] and three [[Fighter wing/Legends|wings]] of [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighters]] emerged from hyperspace in [[symmetric cloud-vee formation]].

Thrawn, ignoring Pellaeon's instincts to flee or summon reinforcements, chose to stand and fight. As the scout ships raced towards the ''Chimaera'', Thrawn ordered three sentry line ships to engage the enemy frigates. The [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] Grand Admiral, observing as the pursuit line shifted and destroyed one of the sentry ships, determined that the New Republic commander was [[Elomin/Legends|Elomin]], and called the sentry line back. The ''Chimaera''{{'s}} superstructure was brought to face the pursuers' vector to provide launch cover for its [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]] and Thrawn ordered the Sector Four sentry ships and TIE Fighters to initiate a [[Marg Sabl/Legends|Marg Sabl]] closure maneuver.

By studying the art of the Elomin, Thrawn knew that the New Republic commander would be psychologically incapable of responding adequately to the unstructured attack profile of the maneuver, given the seeming inferiority of the forces involved. The frigates and X-wings fell back and assumed a defensive posture which allowed the ''Chimaera'' to take the fight to them. As a result, the entire New Republic task force was destroyed.
